mapper.select: SELECT g.id,g.version,r.capabilities_json,g.scope,s.rule_json,CASE WHEN g.source_type='GROUP' THEN least(g.valid_to,m.valid_to,((clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE src.business_zone)::date+1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE src.business_zone) ELSE least(g.valid_to,m.valid_to) END valid_to FROM auth_governance.access_grant g JOIN auth_governance.role_version r ON r.id=g.role_id AND r.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND r.application_id=g.application_id AND r.environment=g.environment LEFT JOIN auth_governance.grant_scope s ON s.grant_id=g.id AND s.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND s.application_id=g.application_id AND s.environment=g.environment JOIN auth_governance.membership m ON m.id=#{member} AND m.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND m.generation=#{generation} LEFT JOIN auth_governance.directory_group dg ON dg.id=g.group_id AND dg.tenant_id=g.tenant_id LEFT JOIN auth_governance.directory_source src ON src.id=dg.source_id AND src.tenant_id=g.tenant_id JOIN auth_governance.principal u ON u.id=m.principal_id WHERE g.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND g.application_id=#{p.applicationId} AND g.environment=#{p.environment} AND g.state='ACTIVE' AND ( (g.source_type IN ('DIRECT','OA_REQUEST') AND g.membership_id=m.id AND g.generation=m.generation) OR (g.source_type='GROUP' AND dg.active AND src.environment=g.environment AND NOT src.quarantined AND src.business_zone IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth_governance.directory_group_member gm WHERE gm.group_id=dg.id AND gm.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND gm.membership_id=m.id AND gm.generation=m.generation AND gm.current AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(gm.periods) a WHERE (a->>'valid_from')::date <=(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE src.business_zone)::date AND (a->>'valid_to' IS NULL OR (a->>'valid_to')::date >(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE src.business_zone)::date))))) AND g.valid_from <=clock_timestamp() AND g.valid_to >clock_timestamp() AND m.status='ACTIVE' AND u.status='ACTIVE' AND u.kind='HUMAN' AND m.valid_from <=clock_timestamp() AND (m.valid_to IS NULL OR m.valid_to >clock_timestamp()) ORDER BY g.id LIMIT 101
